entities.name: Saskia the Unyielding
entities.description: A legendary human soldier from an unknown plane, sole survivor of a massacre of her village.

entities.name: Invading army
entities.description: Army from across the sea that massacred Saskia's village.

events.summary: Saskia survives an invading army's massacre of her village and spends almost ten years building a stone monument.
events.quote: a task Saskia worked at in solitude for almost ten years

events.summary: Thousands of warriors come to see Saskia place the final stone.
events.quote: thousands of warriors journeyed to see Saskia place the final stone

events.summary: Saskia brings war to her enemies' doorsteps with a host behind her.
events.quote: Saskia brought war to the doorsteps of her enemies

relations.note: They massacred her village; she took vengeance.
relations.quote: her mind turned from mourning to vengeance
